brief: Professional photo studio, 12m x 8m rectangular floor plan, 4m ceiling height. Main shooting area occupies the front 8m x 8m zone. The back 4m x 8m is split into a 4m x 4m equipment storage room on the left and a 4m x 4m client lounge on the right, separated by an internal wall. Main entry door at center of the south (12m) wall, 1.2m wide double door. Two large north-facing windows on the north wall, each 2m wide. The shooting area has: 2 professional camera tripods, 2 backdrop stands (2.7m tall), 3 studio strobe lights on wheeled stands, 1 large reflector panel, 2 studio stools, 1 tethering workstation desk with monitor. Equipment storage has: 2 equipment shelving racks, 1 gear table. Client lounge has: 1 leather sofa (3-seater), 1 coffee table, 2 accent chairs. Walls are matte white for controlled lighting. Polished concrete floor throughout. The studio area has a track lighting rail system on the ceiling.
